t: YunSCM 20 × 4.0–4.5 Fat Bike Inner Tubes – Heavy Duty, 32mm Schrader, Pair
x: YunSCM 20 × 4.0–4.5 Fat Bike Inner Tubes – Heavy Duty, 32mm Schrader, Pair Bicycle Inner Tube Cycling Parts & Accessories Tyres Tyres & Inner Tubes YunSCM YunSCM 20 × 4.0–4.5 Heavy Duty Fat Bike Inner Tubes This pair of YunSCM heavy duty inner tubes fits compatible 20 × 4.0–4.5 fat bike tyres, marked ETRTO 102/114-406. Each tube has a straight 32mm Schrader valve (AV), for fat bicycles and e-bikes with matching tyre and rim specifications. Pack contains two inner tubes. Tyres and wheels are not included. Key features Heavy duty butyl and EPDM rubber construction. Fits compatible 20-inch fat tyres from 4.0 to 4.5 inches wide. Straight Schrader valves, also known as AV or car-type valves. A two-tube pack for replacing both tubes or keeping a spare. Specifications Brand YunSCM Product Heavy duty bicycle inner tubes Quantity 2 inner tubes Tyre size 20 × 4.0–4.5 inches ETRTO size 102/114-406 Valve Straight Schrader / AV Valve length 32mm Material Butyl and EPDM rubber Colour Black Will these inner tubes fit my fat bike? Match the size printed on your tyre sidewall and existing tube, including the ETRTO rim diameter. This size range includes 20 × 4.0, 20 × 4.25 and 20 × 4.5 tyres with the matching 406mm rim diameter. Check that your rim accepts a Schrader valve and that a 32mm valve is long enough for the rim depth and pump connection. Compatibility depends on the tyre size, rim and valve fit, rather than the bike brand alone. If you are unsure, contact us with a photo of the tyre markings and valve. Fitting guidance Inspect the tyre, rim and rim tape for damage or sharp objects before fitting. Add just enough air to give the tube shape, fit the valve straight, and take care not to trap the tube beneath the tyre bead. Inflate gradually within the limits stated for your tyre and rim. Heavy duty tubes can still puncture. Check tyre pressure regularly and replace any damaged tube or valve. Browse our tyres and inner tubes for other sizes.
